principles: ${ROM_ROOT} is selected through SAF or discovered on the specific device; no physical mount is assumed.
No packages, settings, drivers, storage grants, or app-private files are changed by this profile.
Never put BIOS, firmware, title keys, account credentials, or their contents in a profile, report, or log.

THERMAL POLICY: sustained device temps above ~75C are unacceptable for long-term health. Prefer lower internal resolution (2x-3x over 4x on demanding titles), cap FPS at 60, avoid charging while playing, and use per-game reductions instead of global max settings. A custom GPU driver (Turnip) is more efficient than stock, not hotter; the workload, not the driver, drives heat.

manual: Choose a writable data directory (recommended: selected card/cocoon) and grant storage through the Android picker.
Use selected ROM root; enable Smart Folders, add mappings only after launching a game, rescan and scrape.
Enter SteamGridDB/ScreenScraper/RetroAchievements credentials on device; never store them in automation.
Set as Home only after launch and Back navigation pass.

appearance.recommended_theme: browse Silk Pod; community picks include PhantomOS, FloatUI, Persona-Wii, BotW, Balatro
appearance.grid_editing: Start -> Edit Grid -> press Y to resize tiles; reposition logos over hero art on the info screen
appearance.widgets: ThemePlaza badges can be added as image widgets on the home grid
manual_tasks: Install and combine theme elements in Silk Pod; themes are modular (colors/wallpapers/icons/sounds from different themes).
Optionally enable Glass surface material and tune blur/tint to taste.
Create one Platform Smart Folder per owned platform (Start -> New -> Smart Folder -> Platform); each auto-fills from ROMs/<platform>/ and gets its platform color + icon.
Scrape box art per game with SteamGridDB prioritized; use the asset picker for per-game icon/hero/logo; reposition logos over hero art. Scrape in ES-DE first and use ES-DE linking when available.
Edit the home grid: resize favorite tiles, place ThemePlaza badge widgets.
Typography: pick a Silk Pod/Theme Studio theme whose font you like (Theme Studio exports a ZIP; Settings -> Personalization -> Theme -> Import ZIP).
Verify box art, logos and backgrounds render on BOTH screens before setting Cocoon as Home.

manual: Manually import staged RetroArch cfg then verify selected BIOS folder.

Select Vulkan, update core info/assets/GLSL/Slang shaders, and install FBNeo, MAME 2003-Plus, Gambatte, mGBA, Nestopia UE, SNES9x, Flycast, Genesis Plus GX, Beetle Saturn; test N64 GLES3 cores individually.
Hotkeys: Select enable; Select+X menu; Select+Start exit; Select+R2 fast-forward; Select+L1/R1 load/save; Select+Y FPS; Select+Right run-ahead. Confirm auto save/load and no quit confirmation.
Optional guide presets: LCD3x for GB, CRT Geom Deluxe with curvature off for consoles, N64 1440x1080; validate core/version compatibility.
Complete user-folder and ROM-folder SAF selections; import personally dumped data only if needed.
Start Vulkan, async shaders, 4x, top/bottom dual layout, Disable Right Eye Render, and controller overlay off; lower/change per game.
Verify touch/stylus and mappings: Select+Start exit, Select+R2 fast-forward, Select+L1/R1 load/save, Select+Y FPS, Select+Right screen layout.
Alternative staged fork: AzaharPlus 2126.0-A (reads .3ds/.cci directly, keeps current with upstream; install the coexists variant so stock Azahar stays).
THERMAL: drop to 2x-3x for demanding 3DS titles (Pokemon XY/ORAS, Xenoblade) if device exceeds ~75C; 3DS rarely needs 4x to look right.
Choose ROM folder and personally dumped DS BIOS/firmware only if required.
Start OpenGL, 4x, internal-top/external-bottom dual-screen preset; verify touch input.
There is no exit hotkey recommendation. Verify R2 fast-forward, R3 save, L3 load before frontend mapping.
Use the app picker for user-provided prod.keys and firmware; never automate copying them.
Select ROM folder, docked mode and verify A/B/X/Y.
Validate an exact GPU driver/version manually; Mr. Purple/Turnip advice is not universal. Install updates/DLC through Manage Data only after title-ID/ownership checks.

THERMAL: Switch is the heaviest workload on the Thor. Cap FPS at 60 (uncapped only for games that hold it), prefer handheld resolution scaling, and reduce per-game before reducing globally. If device exceeds ~75C sustained, docked mode off and 1x docked resolution are the levers.
THERMAL: never charge while playing demanding Switch titles; charge to ~80-90% before sessions instead.
Add GC and Wii folders through SAF; use OpenGL, compile shaders before starting, 3x, 4:3, dual core, cheats and save states as needed.
Choose NTSC-U where appropriate and separately map/test GameCube and Wii controls, renderer, and dual-screen behavior.
Select game folder and user-dumped keys via app; validate each title.
Configure gamepad screen and turn overlay off; apply graphics packs per game.
For external display, explicitly test pad placement/show-pad workflow before frontend association.
Dual-screen meta pick: staged CemuDS 0.5.2 fork (info.cemu.cemuds) is purpose-built for the Thor; try it first, keep stock Cemu 0.5.2 as fallback.
Import personally dumped PS1 BIOS and select PSX folder.
Start automatic GPU, 3x, 4:3, widescreen+geometry correction, autosave, one-frame run-ahead, CRT Lottes with warp off, and touch auto-hide; validate each game.
Verify physical ABXY and Select+R2 fast-forward, Select+L1/R1 load/save, Start+Right widescreen, Start+Up/Down resolution.
Import personally dumped PS2 BIOS and select PS2 folder.
Start OpenGL, 2.5x, widescreen/no-interlacing patches; turn off on-screen controls after verifying physical controls.
Verify Select+Start exit, Select+R2 fast-forward, Select+L1/R1 load/save.
Set both PSP data and games folders and test saves/write access.
Start 4x and turn off on-screen controls after mapping physical controls.
Verify Select+Start exit plus Select+L1/R1 load/save.
Install ES-DE on device — PAID app: Patreon (recommended) or Samsung Galaxy Store/Huawei AppGallery; it cannot be auto-downloaded.
Install the staged free ES-DE Companion APK for dual-screen layout controls.
Point ES-DE at the selected ROM root; use the in-app theme downloader (start with Slate).
Let ES-DE scrape first, then in Cocoon 3 enable ES-DE linking so artwork stays in sync.
Set Cocoon (not ES-DE) as Home; use ES-DE for deep library browsing.

recommended.distribution: paid — Patreon / Samsung Galaxy Store / Huawei AppGallery

manual: iiSU is a free visuals-first alternative frontend (Alpha 7.4 staged) — optional, evaluate alongside Cocoon; do not set as Home unless it replaces Cocoon after full acceptance.
Scrape sources and visuals configs are set in-app; treat like Cocoon for credentials policy.
Alpha software: expect breaking changes between versions; re-run acceptance if adopted.

acceptance: Discover the exact package/version/signing data before any install.
Probe only the explicit serial; a future deployer must bind a live fingerprint, SAF grant, storage/free-space preflight, and hashes to it.
Launch one owned title/platform and verify controls, save, exit and orientation before Cocoon mapping.
